_note: The NX-T R2 arm table (data-driven). Edit this file and re-run nxt_r2_derive_cells.py to change the round; nothing else is typed anywhere. Every candidate arm sets the reasoning BUDGET (or turns thinking OFF) of its own Perception and Solver contacts; a node left at delivering_budget_tokens keeps the locked form (budget 3,072). The completion cap stays at completion_cap for every arm, so a budget b carries answer_reserve_tokens = completion_cap - b. At most two candidate arms (owner decision 313 A) and no twin. R1's answer decides the arm table: a one-node scan is e.g. {perception: 1536, solver: 3072}, a node OFF is "off". The delivering arm (the 268-B lock form, budget 3,072 on both nodes) is added last by the compiler and is named budget-3072.
